name: Kokoro: Baka-Monogatari
source: In Kokoro: Baka-Monogatari you take on the role of Player Tuu, the newest student at the all-girls Sakura Blossom Academy. Join her on her quest to find love among her colorful classmates. (That may be harder than she thinks.) Tuu's bizarre adventure will bring her face-to-face with the Yakuza, telekinetic space aliens, and the most terrifying thing of all... meaningful interpersonal relationships.
translation: 在《心灵：笨蛋物语》中，你将扮演图，一名刚转入樱花学院的学生。加入她的旅程，在性格各异的同学中寻找爱情。（这可能比她想象的更难。）图的奇异冒险将让她面对黑帮、会心灵感应的外星人，以及最可怕的东西……有意义的人际关系。
